svg.title: The four simulation levels of ZOMBI2
svg.desc: One simulated species history, its ordered genomes, one gene-family alignment, and two correlated continuous traits. Legends explain extinction, gene identity, nucleotide colours and trait values.
svg.text: Complete history: 30 extant and 16 extinct tips
One row per extant genome; arrows show gene orientation
Gene tree and 72-column DNA alignment for family 1
Two continuous traits on the extant species tree
